name: Titan's Gaze cuts Time Out!'s damage reduction by 75% (#3397)
contract: Titan's Gaze 804462's tooltip clause is "reduces its damage reduction by $s3%". Its effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) and BasePoints -76 -> -75%, class-masked to Time Out! (SpellFamilyName 28, SpellFamilyFlags word0 32768: ranks 802229 / 803896 / 803897). Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 to effect index 0, and Time Out!'s effect index 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE with BasePoints -91 -> -90, forwarded to 802228's SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN as SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0. The modifier therefore lands exactly where the tooltip says, natively, with no script, spell_proc or spell_dbc row involved. This is a regression scenario for that native spell-modifier path; it makes no code change. Rank 803897's base value is -90, so with the talent it must read about -22, a ratio near 0.25. The tooltip's other clause, "no longer breaks on damage", has no positive assertion here: 802228 already carries AuraInterruptFlags 0x0 and never breaks on damage, so nothing would discriminate the talent.
